translations.literal: Xu Daofu led thirty thousand men hurrying toward Jiangling, suddenly arriving at Pozhong.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Daofu marched thirty thousand men on Jiangling and suddenly appeared at Pozhong.

sentences.zh: 時魯宗之已還襄陽，追召不及，人情大震。

translations.literal: At the time Lu Zongzhi had already returned to Xiangyang; urgent summons could not reach him in time, and popular sentiment was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zongzhi had already gone back to Xiangyang and could not be recalled in time. Panic spread among the people.

sentences.zh: 或傳循已平京邑，遣道覆來為刺史，江、漢士民感劉道規焚書之恩，無復貳志。

translations.literal: Some passed word that Xun had already pacified the capital region and sent Daofu to come as governor; the gentry and commoners of the Jiang and Han, grateful for Liu Daogui's grace in burning the letters, had no further disloyal intent.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors spread that Lu Xun had taken the capital and sent Xu Daofu to govern the region. But the people along the Yangtze and Han remembered how Liu Daogui had burned the incriminating letters, and none wavered in loyalty.

sentences.zh: 道規使劉遵別為遊軍，自拒道覆豫章口，前驅失利；

translations.literal: Daogui had Liu Zun separately serve as a mobile force; he himself resisted Daofu at Yuzhangkou; the vanguard was defeated;
translations.idiomatic: Daogui detached Liu Zun as a mobile reserve while he himself blocked Xu Daofu at Yuzhangkou. His vanguard was beaten;

sentences.zh: 遵自外橫擊，大破之，斬首萬餘級，赴水死者殆盡。

translations.literal: Zun from outside struck across; greatly broke them, severed heads more than ten thousand; those who rushed into the water to die were nearly all gone.
translations.idiomatic: Then Liu Zun struck from the flank and routed the enemy, killing more than ten thousand. Nearly all who fled into the river drowned.

sentences.zh: 道覆單舸走還湓口。

translations.literal: Daofu in a single boat fled back to Penkou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Daofu escaped alone in a boat back to Penkou.

sentences.zh: 初，道規使遵為遊軍，眾鹹以為強敵在膠，唯患眾少，不應分割見力，置無用之地。

translations.literal: Initially, when Daogui had Zun serve as mobile force, the masses all thought that with a strong enemy at hand, they only feared too few men; they should not divide visible strength and place it in a useless place.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Daogui assigned Liu Zun as a separate mobile force, everyone thought that with the enemy so close, their numbers were already too few; splitting strength and posting men where they seemed useless was a mistake.

sentences.zh: 及破道覆，卒得遊軍之力，眾心乃服。

translations.literal: When Daofu was broken, in the end they obtained the mobile force's strength; the masses' hearts thereupon submitted.
translations.idiomatic: After Xu Daofu was defeated, they saw how much the detached force had mattered, and all were convinced.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑僕渾、羌句豈、輸報、鄧若等師戶二萬降於西秦。

translations.literal: Xianbei Pu Hun, Qiang Ju Qi, Yu Bao, Deng Ruo and others led twenty thousand households in surrender to Western Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Hun of the Xianbei, the Qiang leaders Ju Qi, Yu Bao, and Deng Ruo, and others brought twenty thousand households to surrender to Western Qin.

sentences.zh: 王仲德等聞劉裕大軍且至，進攻范崇民於南陵，崇民戰艦夾屯兩岸。

translations.literal: Wang Zhongde and others, hearing Liu Yu's great army was about to arrive, advanced to attack Fan Chongmin at Nanling; Chongmin's warships were ranged along both banks.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Liu Yu's main force was approaching, Wang Zhongde and his officers attacked Fan Chongmin at Nanling, where Chongmin had lined his warships along both banks of the river.

sentences.zh: 十一月，劉鐘自行覘賊，天霧，賊鉤得其舸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Liu Zhong himself went to reconnoiter the bandits; the sky was foggy; the bandits with hooks caught his boat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Liu Zhong went forward himself to scout the enemy. In the fog the rebels snagged his boat with grappling hooks.

sentences.zh: 鐘因帥左右攻艦戶，賊遽閉戶拒之。

translations.literal: Zhong thereupon led his attendants to attack the warship's hatch; the bandits hastily closed the hatch to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong led his escort in an assault on the hatch of the enemy ship, but the rebels quickly shut it against him.

sentences.zh: 鐘乃徐還，與仲德共攻崇民，崇民走。

translations.literal: Zhong then slowly returned, and together with Zhongde attacked Chongmin; Chongmin fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong withdrew in good order and joined Zhongde in an attack on Chongmin, who fled.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，益州刺史鮑陋卒。

translations.literal: On gui-chou, Yizhou Governor Bao Lou died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gui-chou Bao Lou, governor of Yizhou, died.

sentences.zh: 譙道福陷巴東，殺守將溫祚、時延祖。

translations.literal: Qiao Daofu took Badong, killing the defending generals Wen Zuo and Shi Yanzu.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Daofu captured Badong and killed the garrison commanders Wen Zuo and Shi Yanzu.

sentences.zh: 盧循兵守廣州者不以海道為虞。

translations.literal: Lu Xun's troops guarding Guangzhou did not regard the sea route as a concern.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison Lu Xun had left at Guangzhou did not fear an attack by sea.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，孫處乘海奄至，會大霧，四面攻之，即日拔其城。

translations.literal: On geng-xu, Sun Chu rode the sea and suddenly arrived; meeting great fog, they attacked from four sides and on that same day stormed the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the day geng-xu Sun Chu arrived unexpectedly by sea. A heavy fog covered the approach; he attacked from all sides and took the city the same day.

sentences.zh: 外撫其舊民，戮循親黨，勒兵謹守，分遣沈田子等擊嶺表諸郡。

translations.literal: Outwardly he soothed the former populace, executed Xun's kin and partisans, restrained the troops in careful defense, and separately sent Shen Tianzi and others to attack the various commanderies beyond the Ling.
translations.idiomatic: He reassured the local population, executed Lu Xun's kin and supporters, kept his troops on strict guard, and sent Shen Tianzi and others to subdue the Lingnan commanderies.

sentences.zh: 劉裕軍雷池，盧循揚聲不攻雷池，當乘流徑下。

translations.literal: Liu Yu's army was at Leichi; Lu Xun proclaimed loudly that he would not attack Leichi but would ride the current straight downstream.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu's army was at Leichi. Lu Xun announced that he would not attack there but would ride the current straight downstream.

sentences.zh: 裕知其欲戰，十二月，己卯，進軍大雷。

translations.literal: Yu knew he wished to fight; in the twelfth month, on ji-mao, he advanced the army to Dalei.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu saw that Xun meant to give battle. In the twelfth month, on the day ji-mao, he marched to Dalei.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，盧循、徐道覆帥眾數萬塞江而下，前後莫見舳艫之際。

translations.literal: On geng-chen, Lu Xun and Xu Daofu led tens of thousands filling the river downstream; front and rear showed no end of masts and hulls.
translations.idiomatic: On geng-chen Lu Xun and Xu Daofu came downriver with tens of thousands of men, their fleet so dense that one could see no gap between bow and stern.

sentences.zh: 裕悉出輕艦，帥眾軍齊力擊之；

translations.literal: Yu fully deployed light ships, leading the various armies in combined force to strike them;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu sent out every light warship and led his whole force in a concerted attack;

sentences.zh: 又分步騎屯於西岸，岸上軍投火焚之，煙炎漲天。

translations.literal: He also divided infantry and cavalry to camp on the west bank; troops on shore cast fire to burn them, smoke and flames filling the sky.
translations.idiomatic: He also posted infantry and cavalry on the west bank, where shore troops set fire to the enemy ships until smoke and flame filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 循兵大敗，走還尋陽；

translations.literal: Xun's troops were greatly defeated, fleeing back to Xunyang;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun's army was routed and fled back toward Xunyang;

sentences.zh: 將趣豫章。

translations.literal: About to make for Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: intending to make for Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 乃悉力柵斷左裡。

translations.literal: Thereupon with full strength they palisaded and blocked Zuoli.
translations.idiomatic: They then threw up fortifications to block the passage at Zuoli.

sentences.zh: 丙申，裕軍至左裡，不得進。

translations.literal: On bing-shen, Yu's army reached Zuoli and could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: On bing-shen Liu Yu reached Zuoli but could not get through.

sentences.zh: 裕麾兵將戰，所執麾竿折，幡沉於水，眾並怪懼。

translations.literal: Yu was about to deploy troops for battle; the standard pole he held broke, the banner sank in the water; the masses all wondered and feared.
translations.idiomatic: As Liu Yu was preparing to give battle, the shaft of his command banner snapped and the flag sank into the water. His men were unnerved.

sentences.zh: 裕笑曰：「往年覆舟之戰，幡竿亦折，今者復然，賊必破矣。」

translations.literal: Yu smiled and said, "In the battle of capsized boats in former years, the banner pole also broke; now it is again so—the bandits will surely be broken."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu smiled and said, "The year our boats were overturned, my banner pole snapped just like this. It is happening again, so the enemy is doomed."

sentences.zh: 即攻柵而進。

translations.literal: He then attacked the palisade and advanced.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked the barricade at once and pressed forward.

sentences.zh: 循兵雖殊死戰，弗能禁。

translations.literal: Xun's troops although fighting to the death, could not be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun's men fought desperately but could not hold the line.

sentences.zh: 循單舸走，所殺及投水死者凡萬餘人。

translations.literal: Xun in a single boat fled; those killed and those who drowned numbered altogether more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun fled alone in a boat. Slain and drowned, the enemy lost more than ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 納其降附，宥其逼略，遣劉籓、孟懷玉輕軍追之。

translations.literal: He received their surrender and submission, pardoned those coerced into plunder, and sent Liu Fan and Meng Huaiyu with light troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu accepted surrenders and spared those who had been forced to join the rebels, then sent Liu Fan and Meng Huaiyu with light forces in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 循收散卒，尚有數千人，逕還番禺；

translations.literal: Xun gathered scattered soldiers; there still were several thousand; he went straight back to Panyu;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun rallied his scattered troops—still several thousand strong—and returned directly to Panyu;

sentences.zh: 道覆走保始興。

translations.literal: Daofu fled to hold and protect Shixing.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Daofu retreated to defend Shixing.

sentences.zh: 裕板建威將軍褚裕之行廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Yu by written appointment had Jianwei General Chu Yuzhi act as Guangzhou Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu appointed Jianwei General Chu Yuzhi acting governor of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 裕之，裒之曾孫也。

translations.literal: Yuzhi was Pei's great-grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Yuzhi was a great-grandson of Chu Pei.

sentences.zh: 裕還建康。

translations.literal: Yu returned to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu returned to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 劉毅惡劉穆之，每從容與裕言穆之權太重，裕益親任之。

translations.literal: Liu Yi hated Liu Muzhi; each time at leisure he spoke to Yu that Muzhi's power was too heavy; Yu all the more personally entrusted him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yi disliked Liu Muzhi and would casually tell Liu Yu that Muzhi had too much power. Liu Yu only entrusted him more closely.

sentences.zh: 燕廣川公萬泥、上谷公乳陳，自以宗室，有大功，謂當入為公輔。

translations.literal: Yan's Guangchuan Duke Wan Ni and Shanggu Duke Ru Chen, considering themselves royal clan with great merit, thought they ought to enter court as duke and minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Ni, Duke of Guangchuan, and Ru Chen, Duke of Shanggu, both members of the Yan royal house who believed they had earned great merit, expected to be called to court as chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 燕王跋以二籓任重，久而弗征，二人皆怨。

translations.literal: Yan King Ba, because the two border territories were weighty in responsibility, for a long time did not summon them; both men were resentful.
translations.idiomatic: King Ba kept them in heavy border posts and for a long time never summoned them to court. Both grew resentful.

sentences.zh: 是歲，乳陳密遣人告萬泥曰：「乳陳有至謀，願與叔父圖之。」

translations.literal: This year, Ru Chen secretly sent someone to tell Wan Ni, saying, "Ru Chen has a supreme plan; I wish with Uncle to plot it."
translations.idiomatic: That year Ru Chen secretly sent word to Wan Ni: "I have a bold plan, and I want you, my uncle, to join me."

sentences.zh: 萬泥遂奔白狼，與乳陳俱叛，跋遣汲郡公弘與張興將步騎二萬討之。

translations.literal: Wan Ni thereupon fled to Bailang, and together with Ru Chen both rebelled. Ba sent Jijun Duke Hong and Zhang Xing to lead twenty thousand infantry and cavalry to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Ni fled to Bailang and rose in rebellion with Ru Chen. Ba sent Hong, Duke of Jijun, and Zhang Xing with twenty thousand foot and horse to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 弘先遣使諭以禍福；

translations.literal: Hong first sent envoys to instruct them on misfortune and fortune;
translations.idiomatic: Hong first sent messengers to warn them of the consequences;

sentences.zh: 萬泥欲降，乳陳不可。

translations.literal: Wan Ni wished to surrender; Ru Chen would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Ni wanted to surrender, but Ru Chen refused.

sentences.zh: 興謂弘曰：「賊明日出戰，今夜必來驚我營，宜為之備。」

translations.literal: Xing said to Hong, "The bandits will come out to battle tomorrow; tonight they will surely come to startle our camp; we ought to prepare for it."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xing told Hong, "The rebels will fight tomorrow, but tonight they are sure to raid our camp. We must be ready."

sentences.zh: 弘乃密嚴人課草十束，畜火伏兵以待之。

translations.literal: Hong then secretly had men strictly gather ten bundles of straw, stored fire and hidden troops to wait for them.
translations.idiomatic: Hong secretly had his men stack ten bundles of straw, set ambushes, and wait with torches ready.

sentences.zh: 是夜，乳陳果遣壯士千餘人來斫營，眾火俱起，伏兵邀擊，俘斬無遺。

translations.literal: That night, Ru Chen indeed sent more than a thousand stalwart men to chop at the camp; fires all rose together; hidden troops intercepted and struck; captured and beheaded without remainder.
translations.idiomatic: That night Ru Chen sent more than a thousand picked men to storm the camp. Fires blazed up on every side; the ambush closed in and wiped them out to the last man.

sentences.zh: 萬泥、乳陳懼而出降，弘皆斬之。

translations.literal: Wan Ni and Ru Chen, in fear, came out to surrender; Hong beheaded them all.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified, Wan Ni and Ru Chen surrendered; Hong executed them both.

sentences.zh: 跋以范陽公素弗為大司馬，改封遼西公；

translations.literal: Ba made Fanyang Duke Sufu Grand Marshal, changed enfeoffment to Liaoxi Duke;
translations.idiomatic: Ba appointed Sufu, Duke of Fanyang, Grand Marshal and transferred his title to Duke of Liaoxi;

sentences.zh: 弘為驃騎大將軍，改封中山公。

translations.literal: Hong became Cavalry General-in-Chief, changed enfeoffment to Zhongshan Duke.
translations.idiomatic: and made Hong Cavalry General-in-Chief, with the new title Duke of Zhongshan.
